The most likely answer is **C**. The son is an intended beneficiary, but his rights had not vested when the landscaper asked to be paid directly, because he learned of the contract only after the payment and had not relied on it, so the parties could still modify the payment term. A is wrong because naming the son as payee is not an assignment, and D is wrong because an intended third-party beneficiary need not give consideration.

CONFIDENCE: 72
